content: आक्रमः, -मणम् .²1 Coming near, approaching. .²2 Falling upon, attacking; an attack; हरिराक्रमणेन संनतिं किल बिभ्रीत भियेत्यसंभवः <ls>Śi. 16. 34</ls>. .²3 Seizing, taking, covering, occupying. .²4 Overcoming; obtaining. <ls>Vāj. 15. 9</ls>. .²5 Spreading or going over, surpassing. .²6 Mounting overloading. <ls>Bhāg. 7. 5. 44</ls>. .²7 Might, valour. .²8 Possession of learning <ab>&c.</ab> .²9 Food. .²10 A step for ascending; केनाक्रमेण यजमानः खर्गं लोकमाक्रमते <ls>Bṛ. Up. 3. 1. 6</ls>.
